NGA.note: Beneficial ownership disclosure in the bill is for fintechs, not the business register.

facts.fact: The National Assembly Library Trust Fund reports Nigeria's Senate passed SB. 959 at third reading on 2026-11-10, a bill to let the CBN designate, register and supervise fintechs as systemically important institutions; House concurrence and assent are not reported.
facts.system: SB. 959, amending the Banks and Other Financial Institutions Act 2020

NGA.note: Consumer interests are mentioned only as stakeholder concern, no consumer rule stated.

facts.fact: The National Assembly Library Trust Fund says the Senate held a public hearing on 2026-03-04 on the fintech regulation bill SB. 959, with support from agencies, regulators and industry operators.

NGA.note: No mobile money service status stated.
